features.feature: Signed frozen review-inventory epoch and gate-consumed receipt with canonical identity, hashes, signatures, persistence, and command surface
Operator-visible epoch status includes cutoff, state, lanes, wave progress, finding counts, blockers, and exactly one next command
Every authoritative producer and consumer revalidates OPEN inventory freshness and material lineage
Unmediated material mutation atomically invalidates the epoch and demotes prior evidence to advisory
Supported Claude/Codex prewrite and commit guards project the OPEN-epoch barrier while consumer checks remain authoritative
Waves consume signed current-cutoff ReviewRun, ReviewPass, Finding, coverage, host, prompt, and reviewer identity evidence
All canonical required lanes and the completeness critic must reach terminal complete evidence
Only a clean zero-new-verified-finding saturation wave can finalize the inventory receipt
Budget exhaustion never manufactures PASS and instead requires bounded replan, decomposition, escalation, or human adjudication
A verified receipt authorizes exactly one aggregated REVIEW-to-remediation-DEV rollback and is marked consumed
The inventory receipt never authorizes TEST and becomes historical after remediation changes material
Post-remediation final-review lanes derive from canonical changed-file and transitive dependency closure, narrow only when proven, and otherwise fail closed to all active lanes
Impact selection preserves host/escalation assurance, binds current story/round/material lineage, and exposes ordered lanes, mode, and machine reason
Broken untracked B-cdf6 evidence link is replaced with repository-resolvable RR, Finding, and exact commit provenance
Deterministic B-cdf6 replay proves at least five historical mutation redispatches become zero with one discovery epoch and at most one clean final-review epoch
Replay retains required lane and host counts and proves zero accepted OPEN commits, stale accepts, critical/high escapes, post-cert mutation, and budget-manufactured PASS
